WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
)
SELECT
  batter,
  ROUND(100.0 * boundary_runs / total_runs, 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM batter_stats
WHERE total_runs >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH first_innings AS (

)

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type <> 'wides' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
)
SELECT
  batter,
  runs * 100.0 / legal_balls AS strike_rate
FROM batter_stats
WHERE legal_balls > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN extras_type IN ('byes', 'legbyes', 'penalty') THEN total_runs - extra_runs
        ELSE total_runs
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls, 2) AS economy
FROM bowler_stats
WHERE legal_balls >= 1000
ORDER BY runs_conceded * 6.0 / legal_balls ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bowler,
    SUM(
      batsman_runs +
      CASE
        WHEN extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN extra_runs
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS runs_conceded,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN is_wicket = 1
          AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS wickets
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
  bowler,
  ROUND(CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / wickets, 2) AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_stats
WHERE wickets >= 30
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_runs AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    d.batting_team AS team,
    SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.season
      ORDER BY SUM(d.total_runs) DESC, d.batting_team
    ) AS rn
  FROM matches AS m
  JOIN deliveries AS d
    ON m.id = d.match_id
  GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
)
SELECT season, team, runs
FROM team_runs
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season

SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.total_runs) AS second_innings_total
FROM deliveries d
JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
WHERE d.inning = 2 AND m.winner = d.batting_team
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
ORDER BY second_innings_total DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed FROM deliveries WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = winner AND toss_decision = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM matches

WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT team1 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team2 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_match_counts AS (
  SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
  FROM team_matches
  GROUP BY team
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
),
team_wins AS (
  SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM matches
  WHERE season = '2023' AND winner IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY winner
)
SELECT tmc.team, (tw.wins * 100.0 / tmc.matches_played) AS win_percentage
FROM team_match_counts

SELECT bowler, batter, COUNT(*) AS dismissal_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket')
GROUP BY bowler, batter
ORDER BY dismissal_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH first_innings_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    SUM(total_runs) AS first_innings_total
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
  GROUP BY match_id
),
second_innings_batting AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE inning = 2
),
successful_chases AS (
  SELECT fit.first_innings_total
  FROM first_innings_totals fit
  JOIN matches m ON m.id = fit.match_id
  JOIN second_innings_batting sib ON sib.match_id = fit.match_id
  WHERE m.winner = sib.batting_team
)
SELECT AVG(first_innings_total) AS avg_first_innings_total
FROM successful_chases
